x: Not a ḥizb but a single ṣalāt upon the Prophet, from the shaykh of Imām al-Shādhilī: the Muḥammadan reality as the gathering secret and the supreme veil, and the petition to be drowned in the Ocean of Unity.

اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مَنْ مِنْهُ انْشَقَّتِ الْأَسْرَارُ وَانْفَلَقَتِ الْأَنْوَارُ وَفِيهِ ارْتَقَتِ الْحَقَائِقُ وَتَنَزَّلَتْ عُلُومُ آدَمَ فَأَعْجَزَ الْخَلَائِقِ وَلَهُ تَضَاءَلَتِ الْفُهُومُ فَلَمْ يُدْرِكْهُ مِنَّا سَابِقٌ وَلَا لَاحِقٌ فَرِيَاضُ الْمَلَكُوتِ بِزَهْرِ جَمَالِهِ مُونِقَةٌ وَحِيَاضُ الْجَبَرُوتِ بِفَيْضِ أَنْوَارِهِ مُتَدَفِّقَةٌ وَلَا شَيْءَ إِلَّا وَهُوَ بِهِ مَنُوطٌ إِذْ لَوْلَا الْوَاسِطَةُ لَذَهَبَ كَمَا قِيلَ الْمَوْسُوطُ صَلَاةً تَلِيقُ بِكَ مِنْكَ إِلَيْهِ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ سِرُّكَ الْجَامِعُ الدَّالُّ عَلَيْكَ وَحِجَابُكَ الْأَعْظَمُ الْقَائِمُ لَكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَلْحِقْنِي بِنَسَبِهِ وَحَقِّقْنِي بِحَسَبِهِ وَعَرِّفْنِي إِيَّاهُ مَعْرِفَةً أَسْلَمُ بِهَا مِنْ مَوَارِدِ الْجَهْلِ وَأَكْرَعُ بِهَا مِنْ مَوَارِدِ الْفَضْلِ وَاحْمِلْنِي عَلىٰ سَبِيلِهِ إِلَىٰ حَضْرَتِكَ حَمْلًا مَحْفُوفًا بِنُصْرَتِكَ وَاقْذِفْ بِي عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ فَأَدْمَغَهُ وَزُجَّ بِي فِي بِحَارِ الْأَحَدِيَّةِ وَانْشُلْنِي مِنْ أَوْحَالِ التَّوْحِيدِ وَأَغْرِقْنِي فِي عَيْنِ بَحْرِ الْوَحْدَةِ حَتَّىٰ لَا أَرَىٰ وَلَا أَسْمَعَ وَلَا أَجِدَ وَلَا أُحِسَّ إِلَّا بِهَا وَاجْعَلِ الْحِجَابَ الْأَعْظَمَ حَيَاةَ رُوحِي وَرُوحَهُ سِرَّ حَقِيقَتِي وَحَقِيقَتَهُ جَامِعَ عَوَالِمِي بِتَحْقِيقِ الْحَقِّ الْأَوَّلِ يَا أَوَّلُ يَا آخِرُ يَا ظَاهِرُ يَا بَاطِنُ اِسْمَعْ نِدَائِي بِمَا سَمِعْتَ بِهِ نِدَاءَ عَبْدِكَ زَكَرِيَّا وَانْصُرْنِي بِكَ لَكَ وَأَيِّدْنِي بِكَ لَكَ وَاجْمَعْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ وَحُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ غَيْرِكَ اللَّهُ اللَّهُ اللَّهُ

Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man minhu n-shaqqati l-asrāru, wa-n-falaqati l-anwāru, wa-fīhi r-taqati l-ḥaqā’iqu, wa-tanazzalat ʿulūmu Ādama fa-aʿjaza l-khalā’iqi, wa-lahu taḍā’alati l-fuhūmu fa-lam yudrik-hu minna sābiqun wa-lā lāḥiqun, fa-riyāḍu l-malakūti bi-zahri jamālihi mūniqatun, wa-ḥiyāḍu l-jabarūti bi-fayḍi anwārihi mutadaffiqatun, wa-lā shay’a illā wa-huwa-bihi manūṭun, idh lawla l-wāsiṭatu la-dhahaba kamā qīla l-mawsūṭu, ṣalātan talīqu bika minka ilayhi kamā huwa-ahluhu. Allāhumma innahu sirruka l-jāmiʿu d-dallu ʿalayka, wa-ḥijābuka l-aʿẓamu l-qā’imu laka bayna yadayka. Allāhumma alḥiqni bi-nasabihi, wa-ḥaqqiqnī bi-ḥasabihi, wa-ʿarrifnī iyyāhu maʿrifatan aslamu bihā min mawāridi l-jahli, wa-akraʿu bihā min mawāridi l-faḍli, wa-ḥmilnī ʿalā sabīlihi ilā ḥaḍratika, ḥamlan maḥfūfan bi-nuṣratika, wa-qdhif bī ʿala l-bāṭili fa-admaghahu, wa-zujja bī fī biḥāri l-aḥadiyyati, wa-nshulnī min awḥāli t-tawhīdi, wa-aghriqnī fī ʿayni baḥri l-waḥdati, hattā lā arā wa-lā asmaʿa wa-lā ajida wa-lā uḥissa illā bihā, wa-jʿali l-ḥijāba l-aʿẓama ḥayāta rūḥi, wa-rūḥahu sirra ḥaqīqatī, wa-ḥaqīqatahu jāmiʿa ʿawālimī bi-taḥqīqi l-ḥaqqi l-awwali, Yā Awwalu, Yā Ākhiru, Yā Ẓāhiru, Yā Bāṭinu, ismaʿ nidā’i bimā samiʿta bihi nidā’a ʿabdika Zakariyyā, wa-nṣurni bika laka, wa-ayyidni bika laka, wa-jmaʿ baynī wa-baynaka, wa-ḥul baynī wa-bayna ghayrik. Allāh, Allāh, Allāh.

O Allah, send prayers upon the one through whom the hidden mysteries were unveiled, and from whom the lights burst forth, and in whom the deepest realities ascended, and the one through whom the knowledge of Adam descended, leaving all creation unable to comprehend him, and before him every intellect was diminished, so that none of those who came before nor those who came after have truly grasped his reality. The gardens of the celestial dominion (malakut) flourish with the blossoms of his beauty, and the reservoirs of the realm of omnipotence (jabarut) overflow through the outpouring of his lights, and there is nothing except that it is bound to him, for were it not for the intermediary, that which is connected would vanish, as it has been said. Send upon him a prayer befitting Your majesty, from You unto him, as is worthy of his exalted station. O Allah, indeed he is Your all-encompassing secret, the one who guides unto You, and Your supreme veil, standing before You in Your presence. O Allah, unite me to his lineage, and realise me through his rank, and grant me knowledge of him, a knowledge through which I may be delivered from the springs of ignorance and drink from the fountains of divine grace, and carry me along his path into Your divine presence, borne and surrounded by Your support, and cast me against falsehood that I may crush it, and immerse me in the oceans of Absolute Oneness, and draw me forth from the mire of merely affirming tawhid, and drown me in the very heart of the Ocean of Unity until I neither see, nor hear, nor perceive, nor sense anything except through it, and make the supreme veil the life of my spirit, and make his spirit the secret of my reality, and make his reality the unifier of all my worlds through the realisation of the First Truth. O First! O Last! O Manifest! O Hidden! Hear my supplication just as You heard the supplication of Your servant Zakariyya, and grant me victory through You and for You, and strengthen me through You and for You, and unite me with You, and place a barrier between me and everything besides You. Allah, Allah, Allah!
According to some, each prolonged “ā” in اللَّهُ should be held for approximately twelve counts.
﴿ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِى فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لَرَآدُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٍ ﴾ ﴿ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا ﴾
﴾ Inna lladhī faraḍa ʿalayka l-qur’āna la-radduka ilā maʿād. ﴿ ﴾ Rabbanā ātinā min ladunka raḥmatan wa-hayyi’ lanā min amrinā rashada. ﴿

“Indeed, He who has made the Qur’an obligatory upon you will surely return you to the promised return.” (28:85) “Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and direct us to what is right in our affair.” (18:10)
This is where the prayer ends in the older manuscripts. Some later copies include the following verse.
﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ صَلُّواْ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُواْ تَسْلِيمًا
﴾ Inna Llāha wa-malā’ikatahu yuṣallūna ʿala n-nabiyyi, yā ayyuha lladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wa-sallimū taslīma. ﴿
“Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe! Send blessings upon him and greet him with complete salutations.” (33:56)
al-Ṣalāt al-Mashīshiyya. Shaykh ʿAbd al-Salām ibn Mashīsh al-Ḥasanī, d. 622 AH / 1225 CE.
